reasoning: Both attempts add the same correct StarterKit.model.json, handle players already in the game, notify once, and retry SetCore inside pcall. A does this with small changes in the project's existing style. B adds stronger validation and a flexible lookup, but it also rewrites existing lines to const, adds --!strict, and uses require("@game/..."). Those changes are unrelated to the task and may not run in the Roblox runtime. B also stays silent when every count is 0. A is the safer one to merge.
